What's new in Vekrun 0.4.2 — Engineering immunity and behavior contracts

• Protect against recurrence: when a Work Item's check fails at one proved commit and passes after the fix, Vekrun keeps it as a protection. Later changes that touch the same code run that check again in their fresh-environment proof, and you can make it required with one click. A protection comes only from real proofs — never from ticket text or a model's guess — and retiring one keeps its history.
• Behavior contracts: write down what the code is supposed to do — or draft contracts from a Work Item's verified acceptance criteria — scoped to the files it covers and bound to the check that proves it. Approved contracts are checked whenever a change reaches them, with every result kept against the exact commit. Drafts stay drafts until you approve them, and editing one keeps every earlier version.
• Both show on each Work Item, next to Change risk and the Evidence receipt, and from the CLI (vekrun immunity, vekrun contracts).
